description: Starts a guest checkout from the user's `email` only (no password) and returns a session `token` plus `userId`, `email`, and `isNewUser`; a new email also receives a verification email. Use it when the user wants to book, with the email the user gave for the booking. Pass the returned `token` as the `sessionToken` argument to `prepare_booking` and `create_checkout`. If the email already belongs to a LockTrip account, no guest session is created: LockTrip emails a sign-in link to that address instead, and the result has `magicLinkSent: true` and no `token`. Tell the user to check their email and finish on locktrip.com; do not call `guest_login` again for that email. A guest session can search, prepare a booking, and pay via `create_checkout`, but CANNOT list, view or cancel bookings, use `get_payment_url`, or use `confirm_booking`. No authentication required to call this tool.
